gabriel_moreno.name: Gabriel Moreno
gabriel_moreno.summary: Pre-pitch glove target elevation, lateral stance offset, and pre-delivery stance stillness timing breakdown across game situations.

tips.title: Glove Target Elevation · CH/SL (High Target) vs Fastball (Low Target)
tips.lookFor: On offspeed/breaking pitches (CH/SL), Moreno sets his target glove 4.2 inches higher in the crouch prior to pitcher leg lift; on fastballs (FF), his target is held strictly in the lower third.
tips.scouting_note: 88.9% precision when target is elevated in early setup (vs 32% baseline offspeed mix). 5.8× visibility floor separation.

tips.title: Stance Stillness Timing · Early Settle (Offspeed) vs Late Micro-Adjust (Fastball)
tips.lookFor: Moreno locks into a completely motionless crouch & target ≥0.42 seconds prior to pitcher leg lift initiation on offspeed pitches, whereas fastball targets exhibit continuous micro-movements until ≤0.18s before release.
tips.scouting_note: Pre-delivery target stillness duration is a high-reliability early indicator of breaking/offspeed pitch selection (85.7% discrimination rate).

tips.title: Crouch Stance Width · Wider Base on Changeup vs Compact Fastball
tips.lookFor: Significantly wider knee flare and base width (0.034 torso widths wider) when receiving changeups to create low-angle receiving pocket.
tips.scouting_note: 100% empirical precision across 17 scored setup fires (10.0× predictive lift over baseline expectation).

tips.title: Target Lateral Offset vs LHH · Glove-Side Bias on Offspeed
tips.lookFor: Against left-handed hitters, target glove is positioned 3.8 inches further to the glove-side edge before pitch execution on changeups.
